authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 700 alagna gives Pali alagga “not joined”, Hindi alag/algā, Old Marwari alago and regional alag forms “separate”. This supplies the modest separate/different semantic change; the link is to this negative formation, not to a superficially similar word for another.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3167 compares Prakrit kittiya, Hindi kittā/kitā and the addenda’s ketti ‘how much, how many’. The geminate or simplified t forms fit the base *kiyatta family.
